observation: Guest audit completed, output exists and no Python process remains. A 10455-byte Get-Content -Raw object placed inside an ordered dictionary was expanded by ConvertTo-Json into provider/type/drive metadata and more than one megabyte output; preceding observation timeouts did not indicate static analysis failure.
root_cause: Get-Content returns a decorated string with FileSystem provider properties. Nested JSON serialization without explicit [string] can expand those properties.
minimal_fix: Cast file text to [string] before placing it inside serialized objects; return compact hashes and byte lengths whenever full content is unnecessary.
verification: Extracted output.value from original response as UTF-8 guest-audit.json; Guest-native Capstone audit confirms both snapshot sites follow the same call.
boundary: Original sample and raw observer untouched; this repairs Host/Guest artifact serialization, not sample behavior.
